description: A student cannot have two exams in the same timeslot.
Assigned room capacity must be greater than or equal to student count.
A room cannot host more than one exam in the same timeslot.
A teacher cannot invigilate their own course exam.
A teacher cannot be assigned to two halls in the same timeslot.
Unavailable teachers cannot be assigned duty.
Teacher duties should be distributed as evenly as possible.
Avoid consecutive exams for the same student where possible.
Avoid multiple exams for the same student on the same day where possible.
